title: gilia aggregata var. candida
intro: Gilia aggregata var. candida, commonly known as White Globe Gilia, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Polemoniaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Gilia aggregata var. candida include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and exhibit analgesic properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic effects.
